versions.changelog:
- Introduced the "review-diagnostics" skill as a comprehensive toolkit for manuscript review, supporting fact-checking, reader simulation, structural analysis, communicative impact assessment, and AI-authenticity detection.
- Defined clear usage guidelines, specifying what to check and which reference files to consult for each review task.
- Standardized review output formats for consistency and integrability with automated validation.
- Provided scripts for pre- and post-review workflow automation, including checklist generation and review completeness validation.
- Clarified the skill’s integration with related tools such as "gpt-review" (AI double review) and "common-core" (shared reference library).
